subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should this PR still add a separate composer-base token meter now that current main already has a context-usage control with a progress bar?
rationale: The branch conflicts with main and duplicates adjacent context usage behavior; maintainer intent is needed to decide whether the exact 2px base bar remains desired or the existing control should stay canonical.

options.title: Use existing control
options.body: Treat current context-usage UI as canonical and only refine that control if a different visual treatment is still needed.

options.title: Refresh separate meter
options.body: Keep this PR open but refresh it onto current components and wire it to the same freshness-aware model.

recommendation.title: Use existing control
recommendation.body: Treat current context-usage UI as canonical and only refine that control if a different visual treatment is still needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame and context usage refactor evidence point to steipete as the best available routing owner for the current composer implementation choice.
